content.page_summary: Reference list (entries 884–891) from a clinical guideline document focusing on cardiovascular disease in pregnancy and peripartum cardiomyopathy. Citations cover ESC guidelines, risk stratification and management of cardiomyopathy during/after pregnancy, clinical presentation and outcomes, long-term follow-up, molecular studies (including STAT3), and trials of bromocriptine for peripartum cardiomyopathy.
notable_topics: ESC Guidelines for management of cardiovascular diseases during pregnancy
Risk stratification and management of women with cardiomyopathy/heart failure related to pregnancy
Clinical presentation and 6-month outcomes in peripartum cardiomyopathy
Long-term follow-up and cardiovascular co-morbidities in peripartum cardiomyopathy
Molecular finding: low STAT3 expression linked to increased sensitivity to beta-adrenergic toxicity in peripartum cardiomyopathy
Therapeutic trials: bromocriptine for treatment of peripartum cardiomyopathy
